name: CSRD/ESRS — Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive / European Sustainability Reporting Standards

articles.title: General requirements
articles.requirement: Sets out the architecture of the ESRS, including mandatory disclosure principles, materiality assessment approach, due diligence, value chain scope, and time horizons.

articles.title: Role of administrative, management, and supervisory bodies
articles.requirement: Disclose the composition, role, and oversight responsibilities of governance bodies in relation to sustainability matters, including expertise and incentive alignment.

articles.title: Information provided to and sustainability matters addressed by governance bodies
articles.requirement: Disclose how governance bodies are informed about sustainability matters and the principal sustainability topics addressed during the reporting period.

articles.title: Integration of sustainability into incentive schemes
articles.requirement: Disclose whether and how sustainability performance is included in the incentive schemes of members of governance bodies and senior management.

articles.title: Statement on due diligence
articles.requirement: Describe the entity's approach to due diligence in relation to sustainability matters in its own operations and value chain, mapping to the OECD Guidelines framework.

articles.title: Strategy, business model, and value chain
articles.requirement: Describe the strategy, business model, and value chain including key products and services, markets, and the relationship between the business model and sustainability.

articles.title: Interests and views of stakeholders
articles.requirement: Describe how the interests and views of affected stakeholders are taken into account in the entity's strategy and business model.

articles.title: Material impacts, risks, and opportunities
articles.requirement: Describe the material sustainability-related impacts, risks, and opportunities and how they interact with the entity's strategy and business model.

articles.title: Process to identify and assess material IROs
articles.requirement: Describe the process used to identify and assess material impacts, risks, and opportunities (double materiality), including the criteria used and stakeholder engagement.

articles.title: Disclosure requirements covered by sustainability statement
articles.requirement: Provide a list of the disclosure requirements complied with in the sustainability statement, including those omitted based on the materiality assessment and the reasoning.

articles.title: Transition plan for climate change mitigation
articles.requirement: Disclose a transition plan for climate change mitigation, including GHG reduction targets, decarbonisation levers, investment plans, and alignment with the 1.5°C objective.

articles.title: Targets related to climate change mitigation and adaptation
articles.requirement: Disclose the measurable, outcome-oriented, and time-bound targets the entity has set for climate change mitigation and adaptation, and progress achieved.

articles.title: Energy consumption and mix
articles.requirement: Disclose total energy consumption, energy intensity, energy consumption from fossil vs. renewable sources, and progress toward energy efficiency.

articles.title: Gross Scopes 1, 2, 3 and total GHG emissions
articles.requirement: Disclose gross GHG emissions in Scope 1, 2, and 3, as well as total GHG emissions, using GHG Protocol methodology and including intensity ratios.

articles.title: GHG removals and carbon credits
articles.requirement: Disclose any GHG removals in own operations or value chain, and the extent to which the entity relies on carbon credits to achieve GHG reduction targets.

articles.title: Anticipated financial effects from climate-related physical and transition risks
articles.requirement: Disclose the anticipated financial effects of material physical and transition risks and potential climate-related opportunities on the entity's financial position, performance, and cash flows.

articles.title: Policies related to pollution
articles.requirement: Disclose policies adopted to manage material pollution-related impacts, risks, and opportunities, covering air, water, soil pollution, and substances of concern.

articles.title: Pollution of air, water, and soil
articles.requirement: Disclose pollutant emissions to air, water, and soil, including microplastics and substances of concern, the amounts generated and the management approach.

articles.title: Policies related to water and marine resources
articles.requirement: Disclose policies to manage material impacts, risks, and opportunities related to water and marine resources, including water management and ocean sustainability.

articles.title: Water consumption
articles.requirement: Disclose total water consumption, water consumption in areas at water risk, and any water recycled and reused, with contextual information on water stress.

articles.title: Transition plan on biodiversity and ecosystems
articles.requirement: Disclose a transition plan for alignment with respect to biodiversity, including targets, actions, and investments to halt and reverse biodiversity loss.

articles.title: Targets related to biodiversity and ecosystems
articles.requirement: Disclose measurable targets related to biodiversity and ecosystem conservation and restoration, including no-net-loss or net-positive-impact targets.

articles.title: Policies related to resource use and circular economy
articles.requirement: Disclose policies adopted to manage material impacts, risks, and opportunities related to resource use and circular economy, covering material inflows, outflows, and waste.

articles.title: Resource outflows
articles.requirement: Disclose information on resource outflows related to products and services, including waste generation, recycling rates, and hazardous waste management.

articles.title: Policies related to own workforce
articles.requirement: Disclose policies to manage material impacts on the entity's own workforce, covering working conditions, equal treatment, training, health and safety, and work-life balance.

articles.title: Characteristics of the entity's employees
articles.requirement: Disclose key characteristics of employees including headcount, gender distribution, contract types, region, and employees with disabilities.

articles.title: Health and safety metrics
articles.requirement: Disclose work-related injuries and ill health metrics including fatalities, recordable incidents, lost-day rates, and key occupational health and safety indicators.

articles.title: Policies related to value chain workers
articles.requirement: Disclose policies to manage material impacts on workers in the value chain, including due diligence, human rights, and remediation mechanisms.

articles.title: Policies related to affected communities
articles.requirement: Disclose policies to manage material impacts on affected communities, including land rights, indigenous peoples, environmental justice, and community engagement.

articles.title: Policies related to consumers and end-users
articles.requirement: Disclose policies to manage material impacts on consumers and end-users, covering product safety, information, personal data protection, and accessibility.

articles.title: Policies related to business conduct
articles.requirement: Disclose policies on business conduct including anti-corruption and anti-bribery, protection of whistleblowers, and how corporate culture is promoted.

articles.title: Targets related to business conduct
articles.requirement: Disclose procedures for prevention and detection of corruption and bribery, including training, risk assessments, and confirmed incidents during the reporting period.

articles.title: Metrics related to incidents of corruption or bribery
articles.requirement: Disclose the number of confirmed incidents of corruption or bribery, related proceedings, and fines, as well as any breaches of anti-corruption policies.

articles.title: Political influence and lobbying activities
articles.requirement: Disclose information about political contributions, lobbying activities, and membership of trade associations, including amounts spent and the topics addressed.

articles.title: Payment practices
articles.requirement: Disclose the entity's payment practices, including average payment terms, percentage of payments made on time, and late payment practices toward SMEs and suppliers.
